name: Macerata (Italy)
description: Quartered red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Macerata (crosses and rings, counterchanged), with three red bars on the lower fly quarter.
history: Municipal flag of Macerata, a comune in Marche; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 17 June 1941.
